unknown_space: That space is not available for recordings. Save the recording to the knowledge base or choose another space.
day: All-day recordings stay in the knowledge base and cannot be saved to a space.
unavailable: Recordings cannot be saved to a space right now. Try again later.
offline: The assistant's computer is offline. Recordings can be saved to the space once it is back online.
outdated: Update Persona on the assistant's computer to save recordings to a space.
in_kb: This recording is already in the knowledge base and stays there. It cannot also be saved to a space.
